title: Lightbearers of Antioch vs Longwu Army
lede: Longwu Army beat Lightbearers of Antioch 34-30 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5, overturning a 23-13 deficit after three rounds. Its cheap Commandery Bannermen decided it: two Troop Requisitions kept the line full, and in Round 5 Longwu held all three objectives for 7 VP while the Lightbearers, their Cultist Troopers, Ashen Chirurgeons and Lucent Exemplars all destroyed, had too few bodies left to contest them.
result_line: Longwu Army win 34-30 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5
deployment:
Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the centre (7,7) worth 3 VP and the flanks (1,7) and (13,7) worth 2. Lightbearers of Antioch set up on the south edge with only seven units beside the HQ (7,13): Lucent Exemplars with Ashen Chirurgeon 1 (3,12), Cultist Troopers with Ashen Chirurgeon 2 (5,12) and The Dawn King (4,12) on the west, the Goetic Ophanim (9,13) and Seraph of Evolution (11,13) on the east. 185 of its 249 RP sat in three big models, so its objective control rested on the 10-model Cultist Troopers and the small squads.

Longwu Army filled row 2 with thirteen units: six Commandery Bannermen, the White Pole Guard under the Five-Banner Marshal (9,2), Terracotta Vanguard, Azure Banner Braves and the War-Taoist with Commandery Bannermen 1, and put both Vermillion Rocket Batteries on the back row at (4,0) and (10,0). The width meant every objective could be reached by a Bannermen squad; the rockets covered the whole centre from their start squares.

Primaries: Lightbearers took BREAK THEIR HOLD (1 VP per enemy-held objective it contests, 3 for flipping one), Longwu took IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS (1 VP per 2 healthy units outside its deployment zone, up to 3).

1.title: The rockets erase the Cultist Troopers

feed.text: Lightbearers spent 1 CP on a Scouting Order for The Dawn King (PER +2); it spotted nothing new and bought nothing. Secondaries kept: INTO THE FRAY for Lightbearers, SECURE THE FLANKS for Longwu.

Both armies advanced to the objective line. Cultist Troopers and Ashen Chirurgeon 2 went to 2,8 by the west objective, the Goetic Ophanim to 12,7 on the east one, and The Dawn King (6,7), Lucent Exemplars (6,8) and the Seraph of Evolution (8,8) around the centre. Longwu put Commandery Bannermen 6 (7,6), Terracotta Vanguard (8,6) and Azure Banner Braves (8,7) on (7,7).

Nobody else was in range, but both Vermillion Rocket Batteries reached 2,8 from the back row: 10 damage each destroyed the 20-HP Cultist Troopers outright and took 2 off Ashen Chirurgeon 2, and Burning took 2 more.

Lightbearers scored the flanks, (1,7) through the lone Ashen Chirurgeon 2 (OC 1 vs 0) and (13,7) through the Goetic Ophanim, for 4 VP, plus 1 VP of BREAK THEIR HOLD for contesting the centre. Longwu took (7,7) at OC 26 vs 7 for 3. 5-3.

Lightbearers paid 2 CP for Double Time on Lucent Exemplars; the charge was in reach without it. Longwu paid 2 CP for Double Time on the White Pole Guard and 3 CP for a Troop Requisition, a fresh Commandery Bannermen at (7,2). Mana: Lightbearers +5, Longwu +2. New secondaries: DEEP REACH and OBJECTIVE RELAY.

Ashen Chirurgeon 2 charged Commandery Bannermen 2 from 2,8 (INTO THE FRAY, +2 VP), the Seraph of Evolution charged the Azure Banner Braves and Lucent Exemplars charged Commandery Bannermen 6. All three targets fell back: Bannermen 2 to 5,4, Bannermen 6 in disorder to 8,6 (1 damage, then 1 more from The Dawn King's Overwatch), the Braves in disorder to 8,3 (2 True Damage, one Brave). Terracotta Vanguard charged the Goetic Ophanim, which had left (13,7) for 8,9. The White Pole Guard used its Double Time to reach 12,4, then the Marshal's To Formation! pulled it back to 9,5 in the Action Phase.

The Dawn King put 6 damage on Commandery Bannermen 6 and Burning finished it. Commandery Bannermen 4 shot Ashen Chirurgeon 2 dead (2 damage). Rocket Battery 2 hit Lucent Exemplars for 2; four Longwu units fired at The Dawn King for 2. The Seraph and Lucent Exemplars, their targets gone, had nothing to do.

Lightbearers held (7,7) at OC 10 vs 0 (3 VP), scored BREAK THEIR HOLD at 3 for flipping it, and DEEP REACH (+3). Longwu took (1,7) through Commandery Bannermen 4 (2 VP), IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS 3 and SECURE THE FLANKS (+2 VP, +1 CP). 16-10.
Lightbearers spent 3 CP on a Troop Requisition: new Cultist Troopers at (6,12). New secondaries: STRONGPOINT and FORWARD PRESENCE.

The White Pole Guard and Five-Banner Marshal charged the Seraph, Lucent Exemplars and Ashen Chirurgeon 1 on (7,7). Lucent Exemplars' Overwatch missed, and Longwu spent 1 CP on Go to Ground (0.78 expected HP kept off) and 2 CP on Rally Cry to pass the Guard's Morale Test. The Dawn King left the centre for 2,6 and the Goetic Ophanim went to 4,7, both toward (1,7); Terracotta Vanguard fell back to 8,6.

The Goetic Ophanim cast Fractured Horizon (5 Mana) on (8,6): White Pole Guard -4, Terracotta Vanguard -3, Azure Banner Braves -4, 11 HP in one cast. The Guard's 5 hits on Ashen Chirurgeon 1 did no damage, and Lucent Exemplars' counterattack (8 hits) took its last 5 HP. The Dawn King's Insidious Acheiropoieton failed Commandery Bannermen 4's Morale Test and SUPPRESSED it, which kept Longwu off (1,7). The Five-Banner Marshal's pistol destroyed Lucent Exemplars (3), and the Seraph cut the Marshal down (6). The rockets splashed the new Cultist Troopers for 4 and 2, and Burning took 6 more off them. Commandery Bannermen 2 shot Ashen Chirurgeon 1 down to 1 HP, and Visage of Superbia kept it at 1 HP through its Burning.

The Seraph alone held (7,7) at OC 6 vs 2 (3 VP); BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 again for (1,7) leaving Longwu's hands, and STRONGPOINT +1 (+1 CP). Longwu scored no objective, only IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS 3. 23-13.

4.title: A 1-HP charge hands back the centre

feed.text: Longwu spent 3 CP on another Troop Requisition at (7,2). Lightbearers paid 2 CP for a Rally Cry that passed the Cultist Troopers' Morale Test. New secondaries: FOCUSED FIRE and BAR THE GATES.

Ashen Chirurgeon 1, on 1 HP and already in the (7,7) area, charged Terracotta Vanguard and Azure Banner Braves; the Braves' Overwatch did the 1 damage and it was destroyed. The Goetic Ophanim moved onto (1,7) at 1,6 and the Seraph to 6,7. Longwu walked Commandery Bannermen 2 to 8,7 and Terracotta Vanguard to 8,8, both into the centre, and Commandery Bannermen 3 to 14,6 on the east flank.

The Dawn King destroyed Commandery Bannermen 4 (10 damage). The Cultist Troopers used Desperate Worship and shot Bannermen 2 for 3, at 3 HP of their own; the Seraph took 3 off Terracotta Vanguard. Longwu put 5 on the Seraph, the rockets aimed at it again and splashed 3 onto the Cultists, and Burning destroyed them.

(7,7) stood at OC 5 vs 5, and Longwu's two units there against the Seraph alone gave it the 3 VP; Commandery Bannermen 3 took (13,7) for 2. The Goetic Ophanim held (1,7) for Lightbearers (2 VP). Primaries: Lightbearers 1, Longwu 3. 26-21.

Lightbearers spent 3 CP on a third Troop Requisition, Cultist Troopers at (8,12) that never reached an objective. Longwu paid 2 CP for Double Time on the latest Commandery Bannermen. FOCUSED FIRE expired; new secondaries SECURE THE FLANKS and IRON GRIP.

The double-timed Commandery Bannermen ran from 5,4 to 2,8 onto (1,7) beside the Goetic Ophanim. The Dawn King came back to 7,7 through Bannermen 3's Overwatch (no damage); Bannermen 5 joined the centre at 8,6, and the Azure Banner Braves went to 4,10, close to the Lightbearers HQ.

Longwu's nine shooting attacks did little (Seraph -1, Goetic Ophanim -1, The Dawn King -2) and the War-Taoist spent 2 Mana on Heaven's Warrant Talisman to CHILL The Dawn King; Insidious Acheiropoieton on Commandery Bannermen 5 changed nothing. The Braves ended the phase within 3 squares of the enemy HQ: FORWARD PRESENCE, +3 VP and +1 CP.

Longwu took all three objectives: (7,7) at OC 9 vs 5, (1,7) at 5 vs 2, (13,7) at 5 vs 0, 7 VP to reach 31 and pass the 30-VP target. The Primaries capped out (Lightbearers +2 to 10, Longwu +1 to 10), SECURE THE FLANKS put Lightbearers on exactly 30 and IRON GRIP took Longwu to 34. Both sides over the target: the higher total wins. 30-34.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Both Primaries hit their 10-VP cap, and the secondaries were close: Lightbearers 8 (INTO THE FRAY 2, DEEP REACH 3, STRONGPOINT 1, SECURE THE FLANKS 2; FOCUSED FIRE expired), Longwu 7 (SECURE THE FLANKS 2, FORWARD PRESENCE 3, IRON GRIP 2; OBJECTIVE RELAY and BAR THE GATES still open). The difference was the objectives: Longwu 17, Lightbearers 12, and 12 of Longwu's 17 came in Rounds 4 and 5, when Lightbearers no longer had the units to stand on them.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the units did

Lightbearers: the Goetic Ophanim led the scoring record (7.0 VP, 4 objective VP that hinged on it) and its Fractured Horizon took 11 HP off three units in Round 3. The Seraph of Evolution (6.5 VP) held the centre alone in Round 3 and killed the Five-Banner Marshal. The Dawn King did the most damage (17, the kill on Commandery Bannermen 4) but contributed 0.8 VP: it left the centre for the west flank in Round 3 and walked back in Round 5, 8 squares of moves undone. Everything that gave the army OC died: the Cultist Troopers to the rockets in Round 1 and again (requisitioned) in Round 4, both Ashen Chirurgeons and Lucent Exemplars by Round 4.

Longwu: the 10-RP Commandery Bannermen did the scoring, Bannermen 2 and 3 at 5.4 VP each (about 54 VP per 100 RP) and Bannermen 4 at 4.3; the Azure Banner Braves added 4.3, most of it FORWARD PRESENCE. The two Vermillion Rocket Batteries dealt 17 and 16 damage. Its elite did little: the White Pole Guard and Five-Banner Marshal, 65 RP and 5 CP of Double Time, Go to Ground and Rally Cry, contributed 0.6 VP and died in one charge in Round 3.

{{chart:attrition}}

Longwu lost more RP (85 to 74) and still won, because its losses fell on the Guard and the Marshal while the Bannermen kept their numbers, and two Troop Requisitions replaced the two squads it lost.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI and the army

Some of the Lightbearers' collapse was the army: three big models and few bodies, and the rockets reached its 20-HP Cultist Troopers on Round 1 from the back row. Some was the AI. In Round 4 Ashen Chirurgeon 1, on 1 HP and already in the (7,7) area, charged two Longwu units and died to the first Overwatch shot; (7,7) was then tied at OC 5 vs 5 and went to Longwu on unit count (two to one), a 3-VP swing in a battle settled by 4. Of its 11 CP, 6 bought nothing: the Round 1 Scouting Order, the Round 2 Double Time and the Round 5 Troop Requisition, whose Cultists started on row 12. On Longwu's side, the AI ran the White Pole Guard to 12,4 on Double Time and back to 9,5 on To Formation!, then threw it into three defenders. This is one battle, not a batch; it says the Lightbearers struggle to hold ground once their cheap units are shot off, not that either army is mispriced.

closing: The Lightbearers won the fights they chose, the Seraph and the Ophanim most of all, and led by ten after three rounds. Longwu kept feeding Commandery Bannermen onto the objective line, and in Round 5 the side with more bodies took all three objectives and the match.
